fields.value: Imaging atomic motion of light elements in 2D materials with 30 kV electron microscopy

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains part of the experimental and simulated 30 kV scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) images of 2D WS2, using in particular simultaneously integrated differential phase contrast (iDPC)-STEM and annular dark-field (ADF)-STEM.
